card.text: Red giant in Grus, its granulation resolved by the VLT interferometer.

sources.label: SIMBAD
sources.quote: * pi.01 Gru -- S Star; Spectral type S5,7:

introduction.text: π¹ Gruis is an ageing star 300 times wider than the Sun. Its surface is a few giant convection cells, each a quarter of the star across, seen by the VLT interferometer in 2014.

sources.label: ESO release eso1741
sources.quote: Astronomers using ESO's Very Large Telescope have for the first time directly observed granulation patterns on the surface of a star outside the Solar System

pionier.title: Photosphere at 1.65 µm
pionier.summary: An image rebuilt from interference fringes measured by four telescopes, cast onto a sphere. Colour is infrared brightness.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture, edge darkening or axis is measured.
